notes.title: Announcing my next game... IT TAKES A WAR
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39108183/66c9ec2e90a92dda6404a308dbcc13273f1179d5.png"][/img]
Graphics! Guns! Glory! Get ready to drop into a devastatingly real depiction of the battlefield as you and your team take on a relentless foe. It Takes a War presents a new vision for the team-based tactical shooter genre and is my next mainline game following on from THE CORRIDOR.

It's being published by the wonderful Pantaloon and will be out in Q4 of this very year! Please do wishlist now - it really, [i]really[/i] helps with discoverability:  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3919530/It_Takes_a_War/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: You can invert the y-axis now!
notes.content:
This update adds the much requested option to invert the y-axis! Better late than never, I hope.

It's my first time using an updated version of Visual Studio so please do let me know if there are any weird build bugs I missed! 🙏


[b]FIXES FOR POTENTIAL ISSUES YOU MAY ENCOUNTER:[/b]

- If you encounter a black screen please try resetting your save data by going to the Windows path "%localappdata%" and delete the folder called "THECORRIDOR".

- If you encounter a "missing executable" error please restart Steam and check for updates.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards + New Game Announcement!
notes.content:
ːCORRIDORbuttonː ːCORRIDORbuttoniconː ːCORRIDORcardboardmanː ːCORRIDORdoorː ːCORRIDORmrbonesː

Hello there, Creative Scotland has agreed to fully fund my next game! You can read more about that, alongside my other ongoing projects, here: https://twitter.com/freezenifitweet/status/1622640513114308619

To celebrate, I have finally added the much requested Steam trading cards as well as lots of stickers, emoticons, profile backgrounds, and badges for you to collect. I hope you like them!

As ever, thank you for all your support,
Thomas
